GUI_Dev, the architecture decision was made earlier: **PySide6** was chosen and the entire GUI has already been built and integrated. Here's the current status for your context:

**Completed:**
- **t5 ✅** — PySide6 GUI fully built (7 files, 2,438 lines): gui_main.py, gui_components.py, gui_bridge.py, gui_tab_onboarding.py, gui_tab_live.py, gui_tab_performance.py, gui_tab_account.py
- **t7 ✅** — Integration completed against PySide6 (run.py + SignalPollingEngineV2 wiring)
- **t9 ✅** — All 12 review findings resolved

**Rationale for PySide6 (per my earlier analysis):**
| Criteria | PySide6 | Dear PyGui |
|---|---|---|
| Native tab widget | QTabWidget (full-featured) | add_tab_bar + manual |
| Native table with buttons per row | QTableWidget + setCellWidget | Custom drawing |
| Thread-safe background polling | QTimer + QThread (built-in event loop) | Single-threaded render loop, blocking risk |
| Confirmation dialogs | QDialog with text-match input | Manual popup windows |
| Maturity | Qt 30+ years of production use | Newer, smaller ecosystem |

**Your understanding of the 4-tab layout is correct**, matching spec section 7.2 exactly. Since the implementation already exists in paper_trading_v2/gui_*.py using PySide6, you can review those files as reference. The team is currently at t10 (review round 2).
